Strategy: Reward leftovers between thirty and forty-five and penalize leftovers between forty-six and sixty, sharpening both edges of the good band. It may help by defining the band precisely, but may fail if the penalty hits bins that are actually useful.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (25 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (15 if r - item >= 46 and r - item <= 60 else 0) for r in bins]
```
